chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ḥammād and Faḍālah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a mouse and a gecko falling into the well. He said: “Three buckets are to be drawn from it.”

key_terms.دِلَاءٍ: buckets; the measure of water to be drawn
key_terms.يُنْزَحُ: water is to be drawn out; the prescribed act of removal
key_terms.ٱلْبِئْرِ: the well whose water is being discussed
key_terms.ٱلْفَأْرَةِ: a mouse; one of the animals mentioned as falling into the well
key_terms.ٱلْوَزَغَةِ: a gecko; the other creature mentioned in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a mouse or a gecko falls into a well according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the purification of well water when a mouse or a gecko falls into it. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that three buckets of water should be drawn from the well, indicating a specific taharah measure in this case.
